title: A generalised cross-ratio and limits of local heights
summary: We generalise the standard cross-ratio of four points on a projective line to a cross-ratio of a configuration of four planes in projective $n$-space, the first pair $A_1,\,A_2$ being $k$-dimensional and the second pair $B_1,\,B_2$ being $(n-k-1)$-dimensional, with $A_i \cap B_j = \emptyset$. Over the complex numbers, we show that this cross-ratio equals the augmented height pairing of the corresponding cycles $A_1-A_2, \, B_1-B_2$.
